title: Release evidence
description: What a person recorded about one candidate on real phones (MILESTONE_51_ANDROID_CI_CD.md section 4.2): the device gate of design section 12.6 and the eight release scenarios of section 15.3, against a released engine installed as a user installs it. It lands on main as release-evidence/vX.Y.Z.json by pull request; promote.yml reads it through scripts/check_evidence.py, which also refuses a failed or missing scenario, a handset that is not listed, and an APK that is not the draft's. The file records what was seen, a failure included; the check decides whether it releases.

version.description: The candidate's versionName: its tag without the v.

apk_sha256.description: The sha256 of the draft release's APK that was installed and tested, lower-case hex.

engine.description: The released engine the phones paired with.

install.description: How it was installed: the ways a user installs a released engine (section 6, step 6).

recorded_by.description: Who ran the scenarios: a role or a name, never a contact detail.

handsets.description: The real phones, stock with a locked bootloader, that the gate and the scenarios ran on.

device_gate.description: Design section 12.6, on a real phone with a freshly generated Keystore key.

scenarios.description: Design section 15.3's release scenarios, each once.

patch.description: The security patch level the phone reported.

second_handset.description: Scenario 8 alone: the second phone, which stays idle.
